description: Reviewable modeled role duties for the fictional company. Not employee observations, verified job descriptions or external occupational evidence.

templates.title: Enterprise systems integration
duties: Integrate and configure enterprise systems to meet documented business requirements.
Test changes, troubleshoot incidents and improve service reliability.
Maintain system interfaces and operational documentation.
exclusions: Not a network-architecture or cybersecurity-specialist role by default.
No automatic occupational match or claim of verified vacancy duties.

templates.title: Corporate development and transactions
duties: Screen acquisition opportunities against the company strategy.
Develop valuation and transaction analyses using explicit assumptions.
Coordinate financial and commercial due diligence and summarize transaction risks.
exclusions: Not generic management consulting or routine operations analysis.
No investment recommendation, transaction approval or occupational match is implied.

templates.title: Customer adoption and support
duties: Guide customer onboarding and product adoption.
Coordinate support issues and explain available product capabilities.
Monitor customer feedback and communicate adoption obstacles to product teams.
exclusions: No sales quota, prospecting, closing or revenue ownership is assumed.
Not automatically mapped to service sales representatives.

templates.title: Product discovery and priorities
duties: Investigate customer problems and evaluate potential product outcomes.
Prioritize product opportunities and define requirements with delivery teams.
Review adoption and outcome evidence to adjust product priorities.
exclusions: Not general operations management or project scheduling alone.
No general-manager occupational match is implied.
